Pulse 0.11.4

What's new:
- Press Escape on any child page to go back one level while keeping the Pulse menu-bar panel open. Return and Escape are now disclosed in the existing button tooltips, so keyboard controls stay discoverable without adding permanent interface chrome.

What's fixed:
- Deleting a trade from the transaction log no longer opens a system confirmation alert that closes the Pulse menu-bar panel. Like watchlist deletion, the destructive context-menu action now deletes immediately.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.11.4.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
